design.trigger: A latest guest world snapshot failed to replace its metadata destination. Prior B07 returned failure but did not retain it for retry.
design.retention: Keep one latest failed text snapshot per world file in process memory, tagged with its exact B07 revision.
design.retry: Existing CoopWorker idle callback (2 s) retries at most two file paths per pass, with per-path backoff starting at 2s, doubling and capping at 32s.
design.stale: If current path revision is different, discard stale in-memory retry rather than writing it.
design.worker_start: A failed synchronous fallback posts a no-op job to ensure the idle worker is running even when world off-main writes are disabled.
design.disk_and_locks: All retry writes use B06 staged replacement and B07 per-file commit mutex; world-file map index mutex protects only snapshotting path references, not disk I/O.

limitations: not durable across abrupt process termination; no shutdown flush or fsync implemented
newest in-flight world snapshot can still be lost if a process exits before failed commit is captured
when disk remains failed, previous world file stays and latest world changes remain only in memory
no reliability guarantees for game-owned PS4 savedata or combined multi-file transactions
retry work shares the worker with other off-main tasks, so severe disk stalls could delay those tasks
bounded 2 paths per idle can defer recovery of later paths in larger populations
no real Windows NTFS/game rig/5-player testing or full integrated executable build
separate Supermedo 1.9.8.3 personal-world fix source archive still not inspected; no claim of inclusion
